name: Aid
summary: Bolsters up to three creatures, raising each one's Hit Point maximum and current Hit Points by 5 for 8 hours.

stats.effect: Choose up to three creatures within range. Each target's Hit Point maximum and current {ref:glossary/hit-points} increase by 5 for the duration.
stats.higherLevels: Each target's {ref:glossary/hit-points} increase by 5 for each spell slot level above 2.
